steps.title: Portal Authentication
steps.description: Student authenticates to CampXSync with authorized student session

steps.title: Navigate to Student Lifecycle Desk
steps.description: Verify student lifecycle workspace loads with verified ACTIVE academic standing badge

steps.title: Select Program Transfer Request
steps.description: Student selects 'Program Transfer (TRANSFER)' from request type dropdown

steps.title: Provide Transfer Rationale
steps.description: Student inputs formal justification and program transfer details into rationale field
steps.value: {{DEMO_TAG}} Requesting branch transfer from Mechanical Engineering to Computer Science & Engineering based on Year 1 CGPA.

steps.title: Submit Transfer Request
steps.description: Click 'Submit Request' button, dispatching POST /api/v1/lifecycle/requests through API Gateway to lifecycle-service

steps.title: Verify Submission Confirmation
steps.description: System displays immediate success banner confirming request is recorded and awaiting registrar review

steps.title: Switch to My Requests Tab
steps.description: Navigate to 'My Requests' tab to review submitted lifecycle requests

steps.title: Verify Request Row and Status Badge
steps.description: Transferred request is displayed live in requests table with PENDING status badge

steps.title: PostgreSQL Database committed check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_requests has committed the request with type TRANSFER and status PENDING
steps.query: SELECT id, student_id, request_type, status FROM stu.lifecycle_requests WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a6764861f924' AND request_type = 'TRANSFER' AND status = 'PENDING'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Enforcement Check
steps.description: API Gateway and Lifecycle Service reject unauthorized cross-student request submissions with HTTP 403
